events.name: Bash
events.head: Check walker processes and challenge log
events.input: $ cd /tmp/t242c; for f in walk.pid chain.pid; do [ -f $f ] && { p=$(cat $f); echo "$f $p $(ps -p $p -o etime= 2>/dev/null || echo dead)"; }; done; ls -la /tmp/walk/1-challenge/ 2>/dev/null | head -5; tail -5 walk-challenge.log; grep -c -i finding walk-challenge.log
